filling: Hey Maria! How has your day been so far?
Hey Isabella! My day has been pretty good. Just studying for my physics exam later this week. How about you?
That sounds like a tough exam! Well, would you like to join us for the poetry party we're hosting at Hobbs Cafe later today?
That sounds like fun! I would love to join the poetry party. What time does it start?
The poetry party starts at 10 am. Make sure to bring a Shakespearian sonnet to share!
Great! I'll make sure to bring a Shakespearian sonnet with me. Thanks for inviting me!
Awesome! Can't wait to hear your Shakespearian sonnet. See you at 10 am!
Actually, before I forget, is there a specific theme for the poetry party or is it open for any Shakespearian sonnet?
The poetry party is open for any Shakespearian sonnet, so feel free to share whatever resonates with you. Can't wait to see you there!
Thank you for organizing the poetry party! I'm looking forward to sharing my Shakespearian sonnet with everyone.
Great! Looking forward to having you there. Enjoy the rest of your day studying for your physics exam!
Is there a dress code for the poetry party?
There isn't a specific dress code for the poetry party, just come as you are comfortable!
Thank you for inviting me to the poetry party! I'm excited to join. See you at 10 am.
Looking forward to seeing you there! Have a great rest of your day.
Thank you again for inviting me, Isabella! I'll definitely be there at 10 am for the poetry party. Have a great day!

Is everything else set up for the poetry party, Isabella? Do you need any more help?
